verdict.rationale: The first-party security page commits by default that customer data is never used to train Speech is Cheap's own models, and that its providers are not allowed to use it for training either, so no opt-out is needed. This delivers the story's outcome as a blanket policy. Missing for 10: independent or contractual corroboration (e.g., a DPA or third-party audit) of the no-training commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: We never use customer data to train our own models or allow our providers to use it for model training.
